summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward massive, long-dated bullish bets on the SPX, evidenced by the $24.9B premium and a dominant 0.24 P/C ratio in the main SPX index. Significant directional conviction is seen in the accumulation of SPX 200C and 1200C strikes for July 2026, totaling over $11.9B in premium, alongside persistent multi-day buying in the SPX 6000C and 7000C (June 2026) series. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum or volatility expansion in the SPX, as the massive, multi-session accumulation of long-dated calls suggests institutions are hedging for a long-term structural bull run. Monitor for any reversal signals in the SPXW (weekly) flow, which showed a more balanced 1.69 P/C ratio, potentially indicating short-term hedging against immediate volatility.
